note: 单元通关专属迷你阅读(肢体语言主题,独立短文,不在阅读关出现)。短文2-3句+2题,答案转述非照抄,2题覆盖不同位置。

finalReading.passage: On his first day in Japan, Mark waved at an older man and looked straight into his eyes for a long time. The man seemed uneasy, so a friend quietly explained that lowering the eyes can show respect there. After that, Mark watched the local people and copied their gestures, and soon he felt much more at home.

questions.q: Why did the older man seem uneasy?
options: Mark spoke too loudly to him.
Mark held long, direct eye contact with him.
Mark could not find his house.
questions.explanation: 原文 'looked straight into his eyes for a long time' + 朋友解释当地低目示敬,故直视让对方不安;其余未提或相反。

questions.q: What did Mark do after the friend's explanation?
options: He observed the locals and followed their gestures.
He decided to leave Japan at once.
He kept staring at everyone he met.
questions.explanation: 末句 'watched the local people and copied their gestures'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)的转述。
